newsitem.title: USA: Sequoia Systems sees Q2 revs up to $15 mln.
newsitem.headline: Sequoia Systems sees Q2 revs up to $15 mln.

text.p: Sequoia Systems Inc said it did not expect to recognize a "significant gain or loss" during the second quarter ending Sept 29 of its fiscal year from the sale of its Enterprise Systems business.
The company said it projected revenue to total between $14 million and $15 million during the second quarter, with operating results continuing to show improvement.
But it said it did not expect to return to profitability during that quarter.

"In order to address our customer needs and further enhance future operating results, the company continues a solid commitment to research and development, spending about $2 million, or more than 13 percent of sales in the second quarter," it said.
Sequoia Systems sold Enterprise Systems to General Automation Inc for about $11 million in stock and cash in October.
Sequoia, which report a net share loss of $0.07 for the first quarter, makes microcomputers for industrial and communications applications.
